dataset-release.apps.docs-b0e8fd5e3f6b

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Creator-maintained documentation received separate bounded AI source-content review of identity, construction, human/model roles, formats, access/rights statements and limitations. New human labels or generated rationales/traces are distinguished from inherited inputs. Release configurations, mirrors, source seeds and model names do not multiply family coverage. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes remain in the review records; no corpus download, recount, exhaustive rights clearance, operational audit or model reproduction is represented.
